about_the_game:
Let's begin the briefing Agent, so pay attention. 

Your role? Sounds simple on paper. You show up after a hit, and you erase every trace—every drop, every fingerprint, every clue. The scene must look untouched. No evidence. No questions. No loose ends.

You’ll be scrubbing down entire crime scenes. You’ll bag bodies, dispose of trash, and clean up every mess.

As you progress, you'll unlock better tools and upgrade your skills—but don't get cocky. If you can’t handle the basics, none of it will save you. We’re judged on results, not effort.

This isn’t your average cleanup job.
There are whispers in the dark. Strange figures. Places that shouldn’t exist. The fear? It’s real. And if you’re hearing voices… don’t panic. There is definitely something lurking around.

Every scare, every sound, every piece of evidence—it all connects. This isn’t random. There’s a truth buried in the filth, and it’s clawing its way out.

Here’s the part that gets sticky: You’re deep undercover.

Your mission: Infiltrate the Syndicate, a brutal underground organization led by the infamous hitman Victor Kane—a man responsible for Hundreds of kills, most of which were never supposed to be possible. The Syndicate doesn’t tolerate failure. And they definitely don’t tolerate rats.

Each scene is more than blood and bodies.
You'll find journals, voice recordings, broken phones, newspaper clippings, even symbols and markings. Some of it won’t make sense. Some of it will make too much sense.

The syndicate’s hiding something bigger. Something old. Something that watches from the shadows. I’d tell you more, but I like you alive.

Think this is just about cleaning? Think again.
You're unraveling a web of assassinations, missing agents, weird rituals, and a secret war that’s been going on for decades. And somehow… all of it leads back to Victor Kane.

Once you step into the crime scenes… the real horror begins.

So that’s your briefing. Welcome to the undercover world Agent.
Keep your head down, your tools ready, and your eyes open. And whatever you do…

Don’t trust anyone!"

content_descriptors.notes:
Wiped Clean contains depictions of violent crime scenes with unsettling imagery, including blood and murder evidence. The storyline involves criminal activity, and an exploration of corruption. Sensitive topics such as betrayal, violence are part of the narrative.

There are NO depictions of sexual assault/non-consensual sex, BDSM, drug/alcohol abuse.. Viewer discretion is advised.

name: Wiped Clean PC

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700

short_description: Wiped Clean PC is a horror, story driven, crime scene cleaning game where you play as an undercover agent piecing together a dangerous conspiracy. Use specialized tools to scrub away evidence, discover secrets, and navigate dark, gritty environments in your search for the hitman.
